name: chat-work-log
title: Chat Work Log
description: A turn's work read as sentences: LiveLine (the turn's one moving thing — braille spinner, words, timer, the stuck line), WorkSummary (the settled sentence in the same 28px), WorkLog (muted verb, subject, meta rows and muted thinking notes), ErrorRow and StuckRow, and ChatClock.

meta.whenToUse: The work line and log of an agent turn drawn from AI SDK parts; a turn-level error or stuck row.
meta.whenNotToUse: Answers (MarkdownView) or cards a person acts on (ChatCard).
